issues.detail: The Hebrew says 'the camp of Simeon' (מַטֵּה שִׁמְעוֹן) encamped 'beside him' (עָלָיו), referring to the standard of Judah, not 'beside Reuben' (bên Ru-bên). The Vietnamese adds 'bên Ru-bên' which is not in the Hebrew and changes the location.

The Hebrew name is 'צוּרִֽי שַׁדָּֽי' (Zurishaddai), but the Vietnamese renders it as 'Xu-ri-ha-đai' which is a different name (Zurishaddai vs. Zurishaddai is correct, but the Vietnamese appears to be a transliteration of 'Zurishaddai' — however, the Hebrew is 'צוּרִֽי שַׁדָּֽי' which is 'Zurishaddai' — the Vietnamese 'Xu-ri-ha-đai' is a transliteration of 'Zurishaddai' — this is acceptable. The issue is the addition of 'bên Ru-bên' which is not in the Hebrew.
